title: Use multiple image references in Seedance 2.5 (via CapCut Video Studio) to…
content: Use multiple image references in Seedance 2.5 (via CapCut Video Studio) to maintain consistent characters, wardrobe, vehicles, environments, and key props across a cinematic sequence.
tips: Use multiple image references in Seedance 2.5 (via CapCut Video Studio) to maintain consistent characters, wardrobe, vehicles, environments, and key props across a cinematic sequence.

es.content: Usa múltiples referencias de imagen en Seedance 2.5 (a través de CapCut Video Studio) para mantener la coherencia de los personajes, el vestuario, los vehículos, los entornos y los objetos clave a lo largo de una secuencia cinematográfica.

fr.content: Utilisez plusieurs images de référence dans Seedance 2.5 (via CapCut Video Studio) pour maintenir la cohérence des personnages, des tenues, des véhicules, des environnements et des accessoires clés tout au long d’une séquence cinématique.

ja.content: Seedance 2.5（CapCut Video Studio 経由）では、複数の画像リファレンスを使用して、cinematic なシーケンス全体で一貫したキャラクター、衣装、車両、環境、主要な小道具を維持できます。

ko.content: Seedance 2.5(캡컷 비디오 스튜디오를 통해)에서 여러 이미지 레퍼런스를 사용해 시네마틱 시퀀스 전반에 걸쳐 일관된 캐릭터, 의상, 차량, 환경, 핵심 소품을 유지하세요.

pt.content: Use múltiplas referências de imagem no Seedance 2.5 (via CapCut Video Studio) para manter personagens, figurinos, veículos, ambientes e props-chave consistentes ao longo de uma sequência cinematográfica.

zh.content: 在 Seedance 2.5（通过 CapCut Video Studio）中使用多个图像参考，以在 cinematic 序列中保持角色、服装、车辆、环境和关键道具的一致性。
